newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Resurgent Bunds have potential to 103.22.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Resurgent Bunds have potential to 103.22.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE will rebound after a pullback during the previous session, and have their sights set on resistance around 103.22, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"I'm expecting Bunds to do quite well," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "They had a good pullback yesterday and look ready to go back up."
The 103.22 level was the close on July 23, the same session in which the contract high of 103.52 was set. September Bund futures were up 21 basis points at 103.06 by 0645 GMT.
However, Bunds must also fulfill their obligations to the downside, after gapping up at the open, analysts said. They set a high of 102.92 on Monday, and opened on Tuesday at 103.04.
"Bunds want to fill this gap, and it's not unreasonable support around 102.92," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London. "But overall they're in good shape and will move higher."
She said there was initial resistance around 103.10, and then at 103.18, a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the fall from a high of 103.52 on July 23 to a low of 102.63 on July 25.
"Above there, 103.30 is a pivot level," she said.
Celaya said Bunds were also eyeing the contract high, and then the 103.61 high on March 4 on continuation charts. Still higher, the February 18 high of 104.04 was a major resistance.
He said Bunds were likely to do some "backing and filling" ahead of the U.S. open, but they were not expected to go much below 102.85.
If they did break down there, then the 102.68/63 previous lows would hold firm. The July 21 low of 102.53 was the next line of defence.
At the short end, December Euromarks were down one basis point at 96.53.
